train_model_with_solver: create a Solver instance and call train to optimize a model with quantization and checkpointing
run_one_epoch: run a single training or validation epoch using _run_one_epoch with cross_valid flag
serialize_checkpoint: serialize the model state optimizer and history to a checkpoint file using _serialize
reset_from_checkpoint: reset and load model state from an existing checkpoint file using _reset
configure_learning_rate_scheduler: configure a learning rate scheduler with step multistep plateau or cosine annealing strategies
